description:
Mercury 2 language model

Mercury 2 is served by Inception over an OpenAI-compatible API with a 128000-token context window. Requests are proxied through the UnitySVC gateway.

Reach it through the UnitySVC gateway with your own Inception API key (the byok channel). The endpoint accepts both OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages requests — the gateway auto-detects the dialect, translates to the upstream, and returns the response in the format you sent. See the code examples for both styles.

Pricing — this is a bring-your-own-key (BYOK) service, so it is free through the UnitySVC gateway; usage is billed by Inception directly at $0.25 / $0.75 / $0.025 per 1M input/output/cached tokens.
